title: 聖刻の巡礼 ―凍てつく星の記憶と忘却の回廊―
author: 竜胆 アルト

en.title: Pilgrimage of the Sacred Inscription: Memories of the Frozen Star and the Corridor of Oblivion
en.premise: In an era where the gods have fallen silent and the world's memories have faded into fragments, a blind librarian embarks on a pilgrimage to recover lost history. Guided by a "secret map" etched into the skin of a prisoner, his journey leads him to the "Ice Castle"—an ultimate realm where all despair lies frozen. There, he is forced to confront a cruel truth: the world once perished, only to be reconstructed as a false paradise.

zh.title: 圣刻巡礼 ―冰封之星的记忆与遗忘的回廊―
zh.premise: 在神明缄默、世界记忆支离破碎的时代，一位盲眼司书循着刻在某位囚犯皮肤上的“秘密地图”，踏上了回收失落历史的巡礼之旅。他最终抵达了万般绝望皆被冻结的终极之地——“冰之城”。在那里，他直面了一个残酷的真相：世界曾一度毁灭，并作为虚假的乐园被重新构建。
